description: Ground stations (concept §7 ③). The simulation is planar, so a station is a fixed angle on the Earth's circumference that rotates with it. Angles are in degrees from the launch meridian; the launch site is station zero, which is why it sees the ascent and then loses it like everyone else. A station may declare a localRange_m: inside it the link holds regardless of elevation, which is how range control keeps talking to a vehicle still sitting on the pad next to it. Without it the geometry is right and the answer is wrong — a vehicle at zero altitude is exactly on its own horizon.
